title: Dream Studio grader verdict — completion role
description: The completion grader's I/O contract. A conformant completion provider returns a JSON object carrying completion_score in [0,1] plus its role-specific payload (per-task verdicts and any gaps). Extra fields are allowed. Requiring the role's own score is what distinguishes this from the other three role contracts (WO-VERIFY-CONFORMANCE gap 0a64cf8c).
